reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthWideCategories selection and uses the shared extractTagsFromText tag parser instead of hand-rolling tag matching.

duplication.why: The new rule is added once in the shared selection helper; no logic is copied.

placement.why: The exclusion rule sits in the selection function that every month-wide action already calls, in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Only the selection helper, its comment and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Straightforward to own; the LIKE prefilter plus tag re-check and separate group query add a little complexity but are clearly commented.

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, shared by all month-wide actions.
